# One Dark reference

`one.json` is an unmodified copy from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zed-industries/zed/v1.23.2/assets/themes/one/one.json.

Git blob SHA: `698b8febceaf53daa45fb98eda61b1c35a8d59c6`.

Source view: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/v1.23.2/assets/themes/one/one.json

Zed is licensed under GPL-3.0: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/v1.23.2/LICENSE-GPL

AC1 reads the One Dark style tokens directly from this fixture. It checks these opaque colors as their equivalent CSS rgb values:

| UI surface | Zed token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Window | background | #3b414dff |
| Workspace tab bar | tab_bar.background | #2f343eff |
| Inactive tab | tab.inactive_background | #2f343eff |
| Active tab | tab.active_background | #282c33ff |
| Active tab label | text | #dce0e5ff |
| Empty workspace | editor.background | #282c33ff |
